From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 08:47:05 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Candidate canceled 20 minutes before panel — need condensed debrief and reschedule options

Team — Danielle just wrote in (20 minutes before start) that she’s heading to urgent care and can’t make the loop. I copied her above.

Two options I want to propose quickly so we can close the loop for the panel:
1) Condensed internal debrief at 9:10am PT (10–15 minutes) to capture first impressions and decide whether to: a) hold and reschedule; b) ask the candidate for a take-home; or c) move to a pass/non-pass hold.
2) Cancel the panel and have interviewers submit short notes in Greenhouse; recruiter to propose new windows to candidate.

I can run a 9:10 quick sync for whoever is available (voice-only). Markus/Rishi — can you join for 10 minutes? Monica, if you have immediate thoughts, flag them here.

If we choose 1, I’ll run a brief debrief and record outcomes in the candidate profile.

-Neha
Recruiting Coordinator | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 08:50:33 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate canceled 20 minutes before panel — need condensed debrief and reschedule options

Thanks Neha. I can hop on for 10 minutes at 9:10. My preference: do a short debrief now (capture first impressions and any known risk areas) rather than losing the scheduling momentum. If the debrief is leaning positive, we should give Danielle a clear reschedule window (next 72 hours) before we make a final go/no-go.

Guidelines for the 10-min debrief:
- Quick thumbs (Yes/Borderline/No) from interviewers with 1 sentence reason
- If any No, call it and stop further scheduling unless there’s a strong, documented reason to retry
- If all Yes/Borderline, ask recruiting to offer 2 concrete slots and move forward with a short take-home exercise only if panel requests more info

Markus — do you want to lead the technical note capture?

Rishi
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Ortiz <danielle.ortiz@gmail.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:20:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate canceled 20 minutes before panel — outcome and next steps

Danielle — thanks for letting us know and I hope you feel better soon. We ran a short internal sync this morning and captured immediate interviewers' reactions. Given the late cancellation, the team decided to:

- Hold the candidate in a pending state for now (no pass/fail final decision yet).
- Interviewers submitted initial thumbs and brief notes in Greenhouse; Markus will add technical highlights.
- We are offering two reschedule windows for this week: Thursday Dec 16, 9:00–11:00am PT or Friday Dec 17, 1:00–4:00pm PT. Please let me know which you prefer and we’ll lock it in.

If you’d rather pause and follow up after recovery, that’s completely fine — tell me and we’ll free the panel. We also can offer a short take-home if you prefer an asynchronous option that doesn’t require coordinating the panel again.

Quick note on timing: to preserve fairness, we usually hold the panel open for 72 hours after a day-of cancellation before automatically moving to the next candidate; we can be flexible if there’s a medical note.

Get well soon,
Neha Kapoor
Recruiting Coordinator | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: panel-brief.pdf (updated with initial notes)
